coordinates: Sheet inches from the page's top-left (x right, y down). Panel coordinates: inches from the panel's top-left. A front or back image given on its own covers exactly its panel; a sheet image covers the whole page.

views.front: as you face the performer: the performer's right is on your left
views.back: as you stand behind the performer: the performer's left is on your left
